data.description:
# Intake Brief — Remove 'Market cycled...' activity log (CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC)

## Problem statement

Main Street's end-of-turn market cycling emits a noisy `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard` entry on every turn. This adds little player value and clutters the activity log. The entry should be removed so the log only surfaces player-meaningful events.

## Users

- **Player** — reads the activity log to understand what happened each turn (purchases, income, events, gains/losses); does not want routine housekeeping noise.
- **Developer/QA** — validates log output against expectations; fewer spurious entries makes log assertions stable.

### User stories

- As a player, I want the activity log to omit routine `Market cycled...` notifications so I can focus on meaningful turn outcomes.
- As a developer writing log-related tests, I want no `Market cycled...` entry emitted during market cycling so tests do not assert on noise that no longer belongs in the log.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — No `Market cycled...` log entry.** Advancing a turn that cycles unpurchased market cards no longer appends a `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard` line to `MainStreetState.activityLog` (including the N=0 edge case — no empty-market message either).
- [ ] **AC2 — Card cycling still works.** Unpurchased market cards are still moved to their respective discard piles and the market is still refilled via `refillSingleRowMarket`; only the log side-effect is removed.
- [ ] **AC3 — No regressions in log callers/tests.** Existing activity-log tests and other `addLog` callers (purchases, income, events, re-roll, incident-deck reshuffle, etc.) are unaffected; any test that previously asserted on `Market cycled...` is updated or removed.
- [ ] **AC4 — Testing/validation.** Unit tests verify that after a market cycle the activity log contains no `Market cycled` entry while the discard/refill side-effects still occurred (e.g. assert on `state.discards.*` and `state.market.cards` rather than on the log line).
- [ ] **AC5 — Documentation updated.** Any docs/comments that list `Market cycled...` as an expected log entry are updated to reflect its removal.
- [ ] **AC6 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- Minimal, surgical change: touch only the log emission in `cycleMarketCards`; do not change cycling/refill semantics.
- No new dependencies or schema changes.
- If a doc or test explicitly documents `Market cycled...` as intended log output, that reference must be removed rather than left to rot.

## Existing state

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts:355` — `cycleMarketCards()` logs `Market cycled: ${visibleCards.length} unpurchased cards moved to discard` (neutral). The surrounding logic moves cards to `state.discards.*` then calls `refillSingleRowMarket()`. No other file emits this string (verified via repo grep).
- `MainStreetState.activityLog` is the append-only log consumed by the HUD. Other `addLog` sites (purchases, income, `refreshMarket`, `replenishIncidentDeck`, etc.) remain in scope and should not be disturbed.
- No existing test asserts specifically on the `Market cycled...` string (grep across `tests/` returned no hits); the closest coverage is `tests/main-street/MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` which validates discard/refill determinism. Doc references are limited to a code symbol mention in `docs/main-street/prd-multi-use-card-economy.md`.

## Desired change

- Remove the `addLog(... 'Market cycled...')` call from `cycleMarketCards` in `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts`. The conditional `if (visibleCards.length > 0) { addLog(...) }` block should be deleted entirely; the discard loop and `refillSingleRowMarket(state)` call stay.
- Update any tests/docs that assert on or describe the removed log line (none known to assert today, but verify before closing).
- Add/adjust a focused unit test that exercises `cycleMarketCards` (or an end-of-turn path that invokes it) and asserts: (a) no `Market cycled` entry was appended, (b) the cycled cards landed in `state.discards.*`, and (c) the market was refilled.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts` — Remove the `Market cycled...` addLog call inside `cycleMarketCards` (around line 354-356).
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetMarketCycling.test.ts` — Update or add assertions that the `Market cycled...` log entry no longer appears while cycling side-effects still hold.
- `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` — Verify no stale assertion on `Market cycled...` (grep today shows none, but re-check at implementation).
- `docs/main-street/prd-multi-use-card-economy.md` — Check that no log-entry documentation still lists `Market cycled...` as expected output (currently only lists the symbol name, no change likely needed, but confirm).

## Related work

- CG-0MQSFGOU30078033 Implement Market Cycling System — Introduced `cycleMarketCards` with the `Market cycled...` log line.
- CG-0MQSFGA60005RNGZ Write Tests for Market Cycling System — Test coverage for cycling/refill determinism.
- CG-0MTGX3XSH005VRUI All resource-mutating log entries gain effective deltas — Explicitly left `Market cycled...` unchanged and noted its removal belongs to CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC.
- CG-0MSW6INUT003HLP9 Single-row market logic & commands / CG-0MSTOATDT009BRX2 Expand player hand to 3 slots — Established the single-row market and its refill/cycle semantics.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk — Hidden consumer of the log line.** Another UI path or analytics hook might filter on `Market cycled` — mitigation: repo-wide grep found no consumer beyond the emission site; implementation must re-grep before closing.
- **Risk — Empty-market edge case.** The current guard `if (visibleCards.length > 0)` means empty markets already emit nothing; removing the block must not introduce a new code path that throws.
- **Assumption — No doc contract depends on this line.** PRD/GDD do not treat `Market cycled...` as a specified player-facing contract; only an implementation log. If review surfaces a spec reference, that spec must be updated in the same change.
- **Scope creep — Broader log hygiene.** Do not expand to rework other log lines (re-roll, reshuffle, scenario) — record any additional log-cleanup ideas as separate discovered work items.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Should the underlying card-cycling and market-refill behavior be preserved, with only the activity-log notification removed?" — Answer (inferred from work-item description — no producer input required): Yes. The item states "We do not need the 'market cycled...' notifications in the Main Street activity log, remove them." and the title is explicitly scoped to the log. No change to `state.discards.*` or `refillSingleRowMarket` is requested. Source: work-item description on CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC; verified against the emission site at `MainStreetMarket.ts:355` and related comment on CG-0MTGX3XSH005VRUI.
- Q: "Are there any other `Market cycled...`-like housekeeping entries that should also be removed?" — Answer (inferred): No. The work item is narrowly scoped to `Market cycled: N unpurchased cards moved to discard`. Other housekeeping entries (e.g. `Reshuffled incident deck...`) are out of scope and should be tracked as separate items if needed. Open to producer correction — no blocking question filed because the scope is unambiguous.
- No blocking questions were raised with the producer; no `needs-producer-review` flag was set.

## Interview

No interview was required. The work item is a small, well-scoped task with a single unambiguous requirement (remove one log line) and the emission site, related work, and scope were all determinable via repo search. Intake proceeded directly to drafting.
